an6.103:1.1: Cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ.
an6.103:1.3: Sabbasaṅkhāresu ca me nibbānasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati seyyathā pi ukkhittāsike vadhake,
an6.103:1.4: sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi, anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchanti, kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi, Satthā ca me pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyā ti.
an6.103:1.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetun
